description.en: List of domain name statuses to add.
List of domain name statuses to remove.

descriptions.zh: 本接口用于更新域名的服务端状态
descriptions.en: This operation updates the server-side status of a domain name.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns update-rsp-domain-server-prohibit-status-for-gateway-ote --client-token qwoefasdf --domain-name example.com --add-status-list Status=serverDeleteProhibited StatusMsg=实名认证未通过，增加serverUpdateProhibited状态 --delete-status-list Status=serverDeleteProhibited StatusMsg=实名认证通过，删除serverUpdateProhibited状态 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns UpdateRspDomainServerProhibitStatusForGatewayOte --region cn-hangzhou --DeleteStatusList.1.StatusMsg '实名认证通过，删除serverUpdateProhibited状态' --DomainName 'example.com' --AddStatusList.1.Status serverDeleteProhibited --AddStatusList.1.StatusMsg '实名认证未通过，增加serverUpdateProhibited状态' --DeleteStatusList.1.Status serverDeleteProhibited --ClientToken qwoefasdf
